TRIP STYLE

Sight fishing

Locate a visible fish before the cast. Light, clarity and a careful approach are central to the method.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers who enjoy observation, accurate casts and patient presentations.

Boats & gear

Polarized glasses and a target-specific setup can help. A skiff or a wade trip needs a separate access plan.

Seasons

Ask about light, wind, tides and clarity. A local monthly window cannot guarantee visibility.
